result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and signalized control, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure in a mixed-use area. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The wide crossing distance across the roadway without a median or refuge island increases pedestrian exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside areas adjacent to the crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features marked high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but the wide roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance. The environment is car-centric with multiple travel lanes and minimal physical separation or buffering for pedestrians on the sidewalks.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lanes with no trees or parked cars to provide a physical or psychological buffer.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the commercial building.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signals and traffic calming features like curb extensions, leaving pedestrians exposed on a relatively wide roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection where pedestrians wait to cross.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed right turns by vehicles, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner where the pedestrian is standing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and accessible push buttons to provide clear right-of-way and timing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance, improve pedestrian visibility, and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicular green light, increasing their visibility in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a sidewalk in good condition. However, the environment is dominated by vehicle infrastructure, with parked cars potentially obstructing sight lines and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb and in the adjacent lot may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the sidewalk and in the car lot

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed right turns from the main road.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner near the fire hydrant
